title: VillagerNoAI
description: Proximity-based villager AI disabler for optimization
body:
When villagers have no player in 32 block range, they will get a vanilla **NoAI:1** flag which completely **turns off ALL behavior**, even gravity! Very lightweight and impactful optimization. Use this plugin if you are ready to sacrifice villager gameplay for server performance. **REQUIRES PAPER 1.21.4+**

Config:

```
# Maximum distance in blocks for AI to remain active
max-distance: 32.0

# Refresh frequency in ticks (1 second = 20 ticks)
check-interval: 180

# Minimum MSPT to start disabling AI
min-mspt: 30.0
```
_Note: If you decide to stop using this plugin, NoAI:1 flag may remain in some villagers and you will have to reset it_
